silent_decisions.operation: restrict this sensitivity sample to dyads with non-missing referee bias scores
compute the plotted error bars from a normal-approximation SE of the raw proportions times 1.96
limit the position breakdown plot to the 10 most frequent positions

misalignments.decision: take the 2.5/97.5 percentiles of the bootstrap draws as the CI and derive a p-value from a normal approximation to the bootstrap SE
misalignments.claim: p-values were computed via two-sided Wald tests using cluster-robust standard errors
misalignments.note: claim says p-values came from two-sided Wald tests, but the primary risk-difference p-value is derived from a normal approximation to the bootstrap SE
